newsitem.title: USA: Longhorn says Q4 same-store sales mixed.
newsitem.headline: Longhorn says Q4 same-store sales mixed.

text.p: Longhorn Steaks Inc Tuesday reported mixed same-store sales at its Longhorn Steakhouse, Bugaboo Creek Steak House and Capital Grille restaurants in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company said Longhorn Steakhouse same-store sales were flat or declined slightly in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company also said same-store sales for its Bugaboo Creek Steak House restaurants declined in the fourth quarter, but the decline was not as great as in the 1996 third quarter.
Same-store sales for The Capital Grille restaurants increased in the fourth quarter, but at a lower rate than in the third quarter of 1996, they said.

Anne D. Huemme, Longhorn chief financial officer, noted in a statement that the fourth quarter results reflected a shortened holiday shopping period between Thanksgiving and Christmas as compared to 1995, and the exclusion of New Year's Eve from fiscal 1996 as a result of a change in the company's fiscal periods.
